encounters.approachProse: The sparring golem creaks upright on its spring. Odile looks up from her ledger. 'Whenever you're ready.'
encounters.introProse: The golem lurches off its post and swings!

victoryOutcome.text: The golem's spring goes BOING and it folds in half. Odile makes a mark in her ledger.

encounters.approachProse: Bubbles rise in a wide black pool. Something flat and patient waits under the duckweed.
encounters.introProse: The duckweed explodes and the Fogback Lurker lunges, tongue first!

victoryOutcome.text: The lurker sinks with a final gurgle. That bounty is earned.

encounters.approachProse: A bristle bear sits in the gorse with its face in a stolen honeycomb, humming to itself.
encounters.introProse: The bear smells honey on you and charges!

victoryOutcome.text: The honey thief will not trouble the hives again.

encounters.introProse: A scream splits the wind. The Thornback Gryphon drops off her nest, talons first. There is nowhere to run on these steps!

victoryOutcome.text: The gryphon crashes into the gorse and is still. The cliff stair is yours.

addJournalChronicle.title: The Gryphon of Thornback
addJournalChronicle.text: Defeated the Thornback Gryphon guarding the cliff stair to Gull Rock.

encounters.introProse: A bruiser steps out from behind the boat sheds, hook in hand. 'Jory says you talk too much.'

victoryOutcome.text: The bruiser goes down in the shingle. Jory's crew back off and the beach goes quiet.

encounters.approachProse: Water runs down the spiral stair in sheets. At the bottom, in the flooded bell chamber, the Drowned Keeper stands with his back to you, one hand on the great bronze bell.
encounters.introProse: The Drowned Keeper turns, eyes like sea-glass, and comes up the stairs at you!

tactics.label: Flash the storm lamp in its eyes
tactics.text: You unshutter a storm lamp. The Keeper reels back, blinded, and you see exactly how hurt it is.

victoryOutcome.text: The Keeper sinks into the flooded chamber. The bell rolls free and is silent at last. In his fist, a braided wick: the Everflame.

addJournalChronicle.title: The Drowned Keeper
addJournalChronicle.text: Put the Drowned Keeper of Gull Rock to rest and took back the Everflame.

randomEncounters.introProse: A blue light bobs out of the fog toward you, and it is not a lantern.
A reef crab the size of a cart scuttles out of the surf, claws up.

randomEncounters.title: A Lantern Pedlar
randomEncounters.narrative: A pedlar with a pack of lamps shares a honey cake and the news: 'They say the Guild is looking for new blood. And that the lighthouse bell rings at night.' (+3 Stamina)

randomEncounters.title: A Carved Waystone
randomEncounters.narrative: A waystone carved with a lantern and the words 'KEEP IT LIT'. Someone has left a lucky coin on top, so you leave one too and feel better for it (+15 XP).
